issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #1

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Scott Hanna Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing was in a sticky situation―handcuffed to a heavy refrigerator underwater. He recalled the events that put him into this predicament.

Nightwing and Batman were at the Gotham City Morgue checking some dead bodies that were recovered from the estuary. All of the victims died by their necks being broken, seemingly by hand. Batman informed Nightwing that the bodies floated in from the south of Gotham into the harbor, straight from Blüdhaven . The 21 dead men were all part of Angel Marin's gang in Blüdhaven. Nightwing agreed to go there and investigate.

Blüdhaven's reputation was much like Gotham's, if not worse, and when Dick arrived to the city the first thing he did was stand up for a girl being harassed by two men in the street. Dick gave the girl some money for the ticket back to Gotham and told her to ask for a job at WayneCorp on his behalf. Later, Dick planned to start looking for the possible murderer: a gang leader named Freddy Minh, rival of Angel Marin's gang.

Nightwing suspected that it was the beginnings of a gang war in the city that could quickly escalate into uncontained violence. When he arrived at Minh's place, he found a shootout happening on the street in front of the house but was shocked to see that Minh's people were fighting against Black Mask's False Face Society . The False Facers appeared to be kidnapping the children of the Minh's using a refrigerator. Mrs. Minh wailed about her babies as the False Facers took off in a truck. Nightwing realized that Black Mask was trying to expand his operations into Blüdhaven.

Nightwing managed to jump on the top of a truck and told the driver to follow the men in masks. When he was near enough to jump into the False Facer's truck, they shot at the vehicle to stop Nightwing. Nightwing reached the vehicle and tried to fight his opponents despite being outnumbered. The fridge started to slip out of the truck and Nightwing grabbed for the electrical cord keep it inside the truck. One of the Facers, christened "Foxy" by Nightwing, tried to slash him with a knife from behind. He dodged the attack but the feat cost him his ponytail. Angered by the loss of his hair, he beat almost all of the False Facers and opened the fridge to save the kids but found only a briefcase inside. The False Facers took advantage of his confusion and subdued him, knocking him out.

When Nightwing woke up, he found himself handcuffed to the refrigerator. The False Facers explained that the briefcase contained some of Mrs. Minh's egg cells that were to be used for in vitro fertilization to conceive children. Black Mask needed those to extort Minh and place himself as the main drug dealer in Blüdhaven. Nightwing had heard enough and kicked the briefcase out their hands and grabbed it just as they toppled the fridge into the water, leaving him to drown.

On the verge of suffocating, Nightwing used a magnesium flare in one of his gloves to burn the refrigerator's handle and free himself. The False Facers informed Black Mask of their failure and he reminded them that he wanted all of Blüdhaven under his control and warned of the consequences if they continue to fail. Meanwhile, Chief Redhorn of the Blüdhaven Police Department angrily discussed the appearance of a costumed vigilante in Blüdhaven with Inspector Dudley Soames . Nightwing, not having heard their conversation, cheerily came into the office through the window to drop off the Minh's eggs and talk to the police about Black Mask and his men. To his surprise, Chief Redhorn slapped a handcuff on him while Inspector Soames pointed his gun at Nightwing. Nightwing asked if he was under arrest, to which the inspector responded that he would end up wishing he was.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #2

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Inspector Soames took Nightwing to the middle of a landfill to kill him for Chief Redhorn . They exchanged a few words through which Soames evaluated him, and he decided not to shoot him. Soames was apparently an honest cop who wanted his town rid of corruption and enlisted Nightwing to help him. Nightwing agreed and Soames handed him the keys for the cuffs, but Nightwing had already freed himself. Soames tipped him off to a smuggling operation on the docks that "the law" couldn't or wouldn't do anything about. Soames said that he'd tell Chief Redhorn that Nightwing escaped from him using brute force. In order to make the story believable, Nightwing agreed to punch Soames in the face.

On his way back to the city , Nightwing considered asking Batman for help, but felt that he needed to prove himself and gain experience as a solo hero; he was also annoyed at Bruce's tendency to cut people out and his frequent lack of trust in others. Knowing that he'd need a long-term place to stay, he searched for an apartment and found one in Melville, a section within Blüdhaven. The superintendent of the building told Dick to look around and to come back the next day with the payment; if he did so, the apartment would be his. The apartment wasn't much, but Dick realized that at least he could be near the "action".

Come sundown, Nightwing started working off of the information that Soames gave him. He arrived at the Waterloo docks where cargo was unloaded onto trains. The same False Facers that attacked the Minh family were overseeing the transport and commandeering the train. Nightwing couldn't identify the other parties involved besides Black Mask's gang. Still unsure of what their ultimate play was, Nightwing started looking at the cargo to figure out what was being smuggled, but he only saw old and used cars. He was discovered by one False Facer, who started shooting at him. Nightwing knocked him down, but the bullets attracted the attention of several of his friends. The train had already begun to move and was gaining speed. Thinking quickly, Nightwing took advantage of an upcoming tunnel and jumped up onto the freeway, then used his acrobatic skills to get across. He took out a couple more of the goons, who had assumed he fell or jumped off of the train to the ground. Despite his brief victory over the Facers, he still felt frustrated at the lack of answers and his suspicion of Soames increased.

Meanwhile, at the Minh's residence, Soames returned the frozen egg cells to Mrs. Minh . She apologized for her husband being away on business. Soames had clearly been in contact with both of them before.

On the fast-moving train, Nightwing continued looking through the cars to see if there was anything illicit hidden in them. However, several of the False Facers managed to surround him and began shooting at him with no regard for their cargo despite the shouts of their leader in a fox mask . Nightwing then understood that the cars themselves were the items being smuggled, and intended to cause more damage to the cars by jumping out of the masked men's fire. The one in the fox mask who Nightwing had previously taken to calling "Foxy" caught him by surprise by ramming into him using one of the cars, but Nightwing bested him by luring him into the path of a train coming in the opposite direction. Nightwing escaped the gang by throwing himself onto that train that sped away, ending up with broken ribs.

Soames told Redhorn about Nightwing's "escape" and the chief assigned Soames to the Nightwing case until the vigilante was "out of the picture".

At his place, "Foxy"―whose real name was Reynard―was recovering from his injuries from the collision, saved by the car's airbags. He was visited one of Black Mask's henchmen sent to kill him after failing their boss. Reynard played the fool with his would-be killer just long enough to grab his weapon and kill his former coworker. Reynard then vowed to do the same with Nightwing.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #3

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Ray McCarthy Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing patrols Bludhaven at the break of dawn when he decides to check upon Dick Grayson's new apartment. He runs into the superintendent Bridget but Dick, yet again, can't see her face. He spends most of the day cleaning up his new apartment, he received a call from the phone company with whom he discussed matters about his identity and his non-existent documents and he also stopped a robbery from his apartment's window. Dick Grayson starts to think about the idea of being Bludhaven's protector.

At the Bludhaven's police department, Inspector Soames receives an e-mail. Nightwing wants to meet him at the Bludhaven's dump. Soames tells Nightwing about a possible move from Black Mask at the Zee Moores.

Nightwing checks upon that zone and finds a moneylender working on the place. When Nighwtwing breaks into the small container that the crook has adapted as an office he asks the man some questions which the man refuses to answer. Suddenly a chopper approaches the "office" and hooks the container lifting it up into the air with Nightwing and the moneylender inside. Nightwing manages to drop the moneylender out of the container before some False Facers descend from the chopper into the container. Nightwing faces once again the fox and his gang. All of them start to fight inside the container and that causes the chopper to lose altitude. The chopper pilots decide to drop the load before they crash into a building and the container falls on a building's rooftop. The false facers get out of the container before it collapses completely to the ground. Nightwing manages to jump out of the falling container and using a rope, he reaches the rooftop and knocks out all the false facers. Nightwing ties them and calls for the police and warns fox about Black Mask's possible retaliation.

Nightwing contacts Batman and Robin and tells them that he is still without a clue of those dead people that arrived at Gotham City 's bay from Bludhaven. Batman offers to go and help Nightwing but he refuses the help and tells them that he is staying in Bludhaven because the city is full of violence, corruption and injustice and that he might like that city after all.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #4

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
The female, masked assassin called Lady Vic is looking for Blüdhaven's mob boss Angel Marin who owes her a lot of money. She violently forces some of Marin's thugs to give her the name of his consigliore - the lawyer Maxwell Reed.

Also searching for Marin, Nightwing meets with the dubious Inspector Soames and gets the same lead as Lady Vic. Dick is witnessing a shift of power in Blüdhaven's underworld and perhaps Maxwell Reed is able to answer some questions about it. After getting some sleep, Dick gets up with the intention to make Blüdhaven even more of a new home for him by finding a job. And he quickly finds one as a barkeeper in "Hogan's Alley", a bar which is mostly frequented by cops.

Meanwhile, Soames is cornered by Reynard and two other members of the False Face Society . Reynard had more than one encounter with Nightwing recently and (rightfully) thinks Soames did set him up. But Soames is not intimidated and as he speaks about the true ruler of Blüdhaven, the False Faces get attacked from above. Hours later other cops will find three masked corpses with their necks twisted.

To find Maxwell Reed, a tip from Oracle leads Nightwing to an associate named Biff Tooly who is pretty frightened already because he got an earlier visit by Lady Vic. At least Dick learns from him that Reed might be found on his private yacht named "Quid Pro Quo". Dick does not know that the police is monitoring Tooly and that the officers immediately inform Soames about what's going on.

Later Nightwing sneaks onto the guarded yacht, but Maxwell Reed is able to alarm his guys and a fight starts. It gets more complicated as Lady Vic appears and takes Reed's daughter as hostage.

Somewhere else the missing Angel Marin sits in a small cell. Someone speaks to him via loudspeaker and urges Marin to write down everything about his criminal operations ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #5

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Angel Marin continues to get interrogated by an unknown person and is forced to reveal the underbosses of his criminal operations in Blüdhaven . Interestingly, he calls Maxwell Reed "just another lawyer".

Meanwhile on Reed's private yacht, Nightwing confronts the female assassin Lady Vic who uses Reed's little daughter as a hostage. Lady Vic wants the money Angel Marin owes her and she has no problem killing a child to proof her intentions. But Nightwing is able to attack her and take little Maxine Reed away from the action as Reed's guards start firing their again. Floating away on a jollyboat Maxwell Reed witnesses how his beautiful yacht explodes in a blaze of fire. He is in tears because he thinks his daughter is dead, but suddenly Nightwing reaches the surface of the water and he has Maxine with him. Maxwell Reed is thankful that Nightwing saved his daughter, but he only concedes that he is not Angel Marin's consigliore. The name of the real consigliore is not revealed though.

Lady Vic also was able to escape the explosion, but to her dismay she lost her beloved Bundhi daggers during the fight and holds Nightwing responsible for it.

Meanwhile, Dick works his first shift as a barkeeper at "Hogan's Alley" and is disturbed by the fact that policemen drink alcohol there before they go to work. Once more he is convinced that something has to change in Blüdhaven because the ity deserves better. But that may not be easy because Police Chief Delmore Redhorn still wants Nightwing eliminated and Inspector Soames reluctantly agrees. Shortly after meeting the Chief, Soames sees Lady Vic and gives her much more money than Angel Marin actually owed her. The reason is that Soames looks forward to use Lady Vic's deadly services in the future. But for now, Lady Vic leaves Blüdhaven and turns her eyes on Gotham City. And during a party at the Davenport Estate she makes the acquaintance of non other than Bruce Wayne ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #6

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
After his shift at Hogan's Alley, Dick Grayson returns to his apartment and finds Robin inside. Dick is wary of Robin's visit, thinking Batman sent Robin to check on him. Robin says he came on his own and accompanies Nightwing to interrogate Maxwell Reed for information on Sonny Brewer. Reed reveals that Sonny is responsible for laying off bets for Angel Marin's bookmakers.

As Nightwing and Robin stake out the dry cleaner where Sonny would appear, they talk about their differences as Robin. Meanwhile, Dudley Soames kills Reed for giving away information about Sonny to Nightwing.

Robin wakes Nightwing up from his nightmare about a falling boy to tell him that Sonny has entered the dry cleaner. They wait for Sonny to come out, but when he does not for twenty minutes, Robin jumps down to place a transmitter on Sonny's car. Nightwing tells Robin that it is a trap and gets Robin out of way just as the car explodes. Nightwing takes out the goons who come out of the dry cleaner to attack.

Nightwing asks if Robin will to report to Batman on how he is "not cutting it" in Blüdhaven, but Robin once again says he is not in Blüdhaven to spy on him. Nightwing says Batman will ask, to which Robin says he will tell Batman that Nightwing is making a difference in Blüdhaven.

Elsewhere, a shadowed figure kills Angel Marin, who had outlived his usefulness.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #7

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing finally wants to find out who Blüdhaven's new crime-lord is. Thus, he fights himself through all of Angel Marin's closest associates. He defeats them all and them into a cold storage room. First, no one wants to talk about Marin's whereabouts or his successor. But in the end, Turk Fremunda who controls the Unions tells Dick about St. Anthony's church which is continuously guarded by three guns for hire. Shortly after that Nightwing checks out the area around the church and the guards, but does not try to enter the building.

Meanwhile, the police opens a barrel which is addressed to Chief Redhorn . Redhorn and Inspector Soames are onsite as the bomb squad discover the dead body of Angel Marin in it. His head is turned backwards and his body soaked in formaldehyde to obscure the time of his death. Redhorn is furious - recent developments are not to his liking and he wants Soames to take care of it. That includes the "vigilante" Nightwing.

After his shift in Hogan's Alley, Dick returns home and tries to get some sleep. Again he has some nightmares, but is woken up by Oracle who did some research for him. She found out that it may be a woman named Joyce Elizabeth Desmond who is hidden in St. Anthony's church. Dick recognizes the name and the relation to Roland Desmond aka Blockbuster . He immediately calls his friend Wally West who may have some news regarding Blockbuster. Indeed it was his protege Impulse who recently ran into the villain who may be more dangerous than ever. After a little more detective work, Nightwing discovers Blockbuster's hiding place. And he is not surprised to find Soames there as well ...​

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #8

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Watched by Inspector Soames , Nightwing and Blüdhaven's "crimelord on the rise" Blockbuster get into an intense fight against each other. Nightwing came well prepared, but the confined space within the building makes it tough for him to stay away from the much stronger Blockbuster. The villain even withstands an electric shock by a taser and finally gets his huge hands around the neck of his opponent. But before Blockbuster can snap Dick's neck, Soames points a gun at him. He does not allow his boss to kill Nightwing, because that would draw Batman's attention on Blüdhaven and on Blockbuster's operation. Surprisingly, Blockbuster concedes and quickly develops an alternate plan to get rid of Nightwing once and for all. He shall "die like a hero" without raising further questions by his associates in Gotham.

A little later Nightwing wakes up and he is surrounded by roughly a dozen members of the motorcycle gang "The Loners". Of course they think one man is easy prey, but Nightwing proves them otherwise and defeats the Loners one after another.

Exhausted Dick makes his way home. In front of the apartment house he lives in, a beggar asks him for some money. Dick gives the man 50 dollars and offers more help if the man comes back sober in the morning. But sadly, the poor beggar will not get the chance. A few minutes later he gets beaten to death by an unknown, well-dressed attacker who obviously wants to clean his block from such lowlifes. In another location, Blockbuster kills all members of the Loners because they failed to dispatch Nightwing...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #9

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis: Nightwing swings through Blüdhaven , but suddenly his jump-line snaps and Dick has to pull every trick he learned at the circus to not get killed while falling into the center of a closed mall. He immediately realizes that he is not alone though. First Dick thinks he has seen a man and a child, but then he gets flat-out caught in a shootout of several criminal factions. It takes Nightwing quite a while to escape all the shooters and to find out that it was Two-Face he saw earlier. And Dick remembers the kid Two-Face holds in his grasp - its the same young boy he sees night after night in a recurring nightmare. As in the nightmare the boy suddenly falls deep making Nightwing feel miserable because he is unable to save him. When Nightwing also sees the likes of Batman , Robin and Batgirl looking down at him and agreeing about how he has failed them, it becomes obvious that everything is not as it seems. Actually, the whole sequence Nightwing just went through was created by Scarecrow. The master of fear was called to Blüdhaven by Detective Soames to finally get rid of Nightwing ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #10
issues.synopsis:
Scarecrow puts the screws on Nightwing using his fear toxins and Dick finds himself in an illusion life in which not much goes right for him. He is married with Donna Troy and has two kids, but has a huge inferiority complex. This is not surprising because his neighbor is Bruce Wayne who works in the same firm as Dick but is a rising star there. And it gets worse as Dick gets fired from his job and also finds out that his wife is seeing another man.

But as bad as the fear toxins worked on Nightwing, his mental strength is enough to finally break out and get back to reality. He strikes down Scarecrow and shouts out that the gloves are off now ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #11
issues.synopsis:
Detective Dudley Soames awakes in his own appartment and finds Scarecrow all tied up in another room. Obviously Nightwing did quite a job on Scarecrow so that the villain told Dick everything he needed to know. Of course, Soames is not amused, but at least the fear toxins are still within Nightwing's body - still leading to some fear induced illusions according to Scarecrow.

Nightwing listened to the conversation and decides to get some sleep because Soames is not making any panic moves. Just as he returns home, Bridget Clancy knocks at the door to bring Dick some muffins. As she wants to prepare some tea as well, Dick cries out loud because he suddenly saw Two-Face instead of Clancy. So Dick better gets to bed and Bridget promises to look after him later.

In the meantime, Soames visits Chief Redhorn . The Chief has obviously given up on Soames after the Blockbuster fiasco. He gives Soames 12 hours to settle his affairs before he intends on turning him over to internal affairs. Therefore, Soames tries to meet with Blockbuster, but only three of his associates appear. Soames kills them before they can do the exact same thing to him. The detective realizes that he has no more allies left in the city.

Meanwhile, Nightwing gets back into action and visits Scarecrow again. But their talk is shortened by a SWAT team breaking into the apartment. Redhorn looked for Soames, but only found Scarecrow. With that lead gone, Dick makes his way to St. Anthony's home for the aged where Blockbuster takes care of his mother. As Nightwing breaks through a window, Soames is already pointing a gun at Blockbuster. Nightwing has to take care of Blokcbuster's goons who took some other old people as hostages. As Blockbuster attacks, Soames directly shoots at him several times. But the big villain just takes the bullets, grips Soames' head and turns it around in typical neck-breaking fashion. As the police arrives, Nightwing escapes from the scene watching how Blockbuster is transported on a flat bed truck. What Dick misses though is the fact that Soames somehow still seems to be alive ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #12

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing prevents a carjacking, but the frightened driver loses his head and shoots at everybody which leads to the escape of the criminals.

Meanwhile, the doctors of Rabe Memorial Hospital have a weird case in front of them. Dudley Soames got his head turned 180 degrees by Blockbuster, but somehow survived this incident. He is totally paralyzed and the doctors think he might need another miracle to get him off life support.

As Nightwing returns home, he catches a teenager who is breaking into his apartment. The boy's name is Mutt and like Dick grew up in an orphanage. Therefore, Dick feels a little sympathy for Mutt and tells him him he will not call the cops unless the boy pulls another stunt like this. But after Mutt left the apartment, Dick immediately puts his costume back on and follows the boy to a scrap yard where other teenagers give Mutt a hard time. They burn his makeshift shelter and in the end its up to Nightwing to drag Mutt's unconscious body out of the fire. He hands the boy over to some officers which are able to bring him to a hospital.

Next day Dick visits Mutt in that hospital and has a proposition for him. Dick's boss Hank Hogan agreed to take Mutt in if he goes back to school and stays away from crime. Happy about Mutt's positive answer Dick returns to his apartment and is surprised to meet non other than Batman ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #13

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing and Batman crash a Bachelor party to get a hold of Frankie Deever whose father Timothy "Lunchmeat" Deever is specialized in murder for hire. Interestingly, the heroes do not only defeat Frankie and his associates, but also a third party assassin who had his eyes set on killing the bachelor. Nightwing and Batman put both Frankie and the assassin into the Batmobile in hope to play them off against each other later. Dick definitely feels under pressure with his mentor being in Bludhaven. Batman wants Dick to nail Blockbuster , but Nightwing tries to explain that this city is corrupted in the highest places and one needs perfect evidence for a D.A. to touch a case like that.

While Lunchmeat Deever vainly waits for his son to arrive at the wedding ceremony, Frankie awakes in a container with his alleged killer laying besides him. Nightwing has the container wired and both him and Batman listen how the killer confesses that it was the father of Frankie's fiancee who hired him. Surprised by that information, the heroes return to Dick's apartment. Bruce thinks that Dick needs a better base of operations. Obviously, Dick lacks the necessary money, but Bruce tells him about a trust fund that could solve these problems.

In the meantime, Tad Ryerstad causes another incident in Dick's neighborhood. He clobbers a black man just because he is together with two white children who actually are his niece and nephew.

After dawn, Batman and Nightwing break into Lunchmeat Deever's industrial butchery, but walk right into a trap ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #14

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing and Batman were overwhelmed by the thugs of Timothy "Lunchmeat" Deever and are now about to be eaten by some huge pigs. Nightwing wants to buy themselves time by mentioning that only him and Batman know the whereabouts of Deever's son Frankie . As Deever wants to pull Nightwing out of the pigsty, Batman emits a massive electric shock through his utility belt to free himself and his partner. Deever gives his men the order not to kill them before he knows where his son is. But then he suddenly gets called by Frankie on his cellphone. Obviously Frankie escaped, but so have Nightwing and Batman.

Returning to the Batmobile , Nightwing needs to get off his chest that he does not really appreciate Batman interfering in what he calls his own personal crusade and that Blüdhaven already feels more like a home to Dick than Gotham. This surprises Batman and he leaves stoically.

Meanwhile, Blockbuster hires both Lady Vic and a man called Stallion to kill Nightwing, and if necessary, the Batman as well.

After a short chat with Oracle , Dick tries to call Bruce, but its Alfred that answers the phone. Dick tells his friend what happened between Bruce and him and that he wants to apologize for some of the things he said. Then Dick gets to work in Hogan's Alley and is surprised to see that one of the guests there is Matches Malone ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #15

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Despite their recent disputes, Nightwing and Batman work together again in an attempt to finally bring down Blockbuster . Nightwing wired a few places frequently visited by Timothy "Lunchmeat" Deever. As they listen to a conversation between Deever and his son Frankie they finally hit the jackpot because Frankie mentions several hits as well as a deal with Blockbuster.

As Lunchmeat Deever speaks to Blockbuster on the telephone, Nightwing and Batman storm into his house and confront him with the tape. Now Deever finds himself in a hopeless situation because either the police gets him or Blockbuster will take care of him.

After handing Deever over to the U.S. Marshals, Nightwing and Batman move to Blockbuster's house which is even more heavily guarded than last time Nightwing was there. The two heroes are immediately attacked by Lady Vic and Stallion . Batman suggests to occupy the two mercenaries so that Nightwing is able to reach Blockbuster. The fight between the two is so intense that the building cannot withstand the strong impacts of Blockbuster's huge body. And as another pillar breaks, the whole house which is built on a cliff crashes down into the river. Nightwing escapes just in time, but it seems that Blockbuster got buried in the river. But Nightwing doubts that he has seen the last of Blockbuster.

Later in the Batmobile, Batman assures Dick that he is proud of him and how he handles his stuff in Blüdhaven …

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #16
issues.synopsis:
Nightwing tries to stop a truck hijacking, but gets thrown off the escaping truck and, thus, finally decides to get himself a car. He visits Whaler's Bank to take a look at the balance from the trust fund account Bruce told him about recently. Obviously, Lucius Fox did a great job investing the money, because Dick can hardly believe how high the balance is.

Meanwhile, Inspector Soames awakens from the coma in a special rehab unit of the Drexel Labs. His neck is still twisted 180 degrees and he cannot believe they did not just let him die.

Dick immediately uses his new fortune to rent an old car shop in which he begins to assemble his own car. During a break he chats intimately with Oracle . They talk about Dick's relationship with Batman and about Barbara's days as Batgirl.

In the evening, Tad Ryerstad approaches John Law , an old man who in his younger days was known as the superhero called Tarantula. Tad is a big fan and Mr. Law willingly takes Tad into his apartment to show him some superhero memorabilia. Tad has a rather extreme opinion what a modern superhero should be about and Mr. Law is relieved when Tad finally leaves his apartment.

Thanks to Bridget Clancy , Nightwing is able to follow a trail to the truck hijackers. With his new car it becomes much easier for Dick to follow and to stop the criminals before the police arrives. Overall he feels pretty good about how things have developed in Blüdhaven ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #17

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
In the Drexel Institute Dr. Pavaar tells Dudley Soames that he will need some more micro-surgeries before being able to start physical therapy. To Soames this is all for naught because it is impossible to ever turn his head back around.

In the oldest section of Blüdhaven Nightwing catches two men who are hunting somebody. The silhouette of the creature makes Dick think its Batman, but instead he gets into a short confrontation with the Man-Bat . Immediately Nightwing visits Man-Bat's wife Francine Langstrom and offers his help.

Back home, Dick walks by Tad Ryerstad and then speaks to his landlord Bridget Clancy . Once again he has to turn down her invitation to watch a movie together because he has other obligations. Shortly after Dick left a really huge person appears in front of Bridget and asks her about a free room to rent.

It takes several hours of observation until Nightwing finds Man-Bat. Nightwing attacks Man-Bat and tries to capture him, but then both are shot down by none other than Deathstroke ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #18

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Deathstroke brings the unconscious Man-Bat to his client Mr. Muldoon who wants to produce a video series with the strange creature.

Nightwing again visits Francine Langstrom , the wife of the Man-Bat , to tell her what likely happened to her husband. He promises to do everything in his power to bring him back to her.

Later, Dick returns home and Bridget Clancy introduces him to a new tenant. Dick is shocked as he recognizes the huge villain called Amygdala . But both Amygdala and Bridget explain that he was released from prison and receives constant medication through an implant to keep him in check. Back in his apartment Dick calls Oracle and asks her to find out more about the possible destination where the kidnappers might take the Man-Bat.

While Dick takes a nap, Tad Ryerstad enjoys reading the book about the former vigilante Tarantula. Tad really wants to follow in his footsteps and thinks about a possible codename for himself.

Oracle wakes up Dick and tells him to turn on the TV. They watch a teaser interview of Mr. Muldoon on the news which indicates that he has the Man-Bat on his ship. Nightwing wastes no time and uses his new speedboat to follow the trail. As he enters the cargo room of the ship, Nightwing gets attacked by Deathstroke. They fight intensely, but in the end Nightwing is able to keep the mercenary at bay long enough to free the Man-Bat and to escape with him ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #19

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin Dave Taylor

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing is in Blüdhaven when hears about the cataclysm in Gotham City and immediately runs to his boat so he can drive over and help in the rescue efforts.

Meanwhile Tad Ryerstad struggles to find a cool name for himself that hasn't already been taken.

Nightwing finds several people and their bus trapped in a underground fissure, including a mother and her child named Kenny. They don't believe that all of them will be able to make it out alive before they drown in the flooding waters. The mother of the child tells Nightwing to take him first, then she stays behind to help the others get out. By the time Nightwing is done getting the others to safety the fissure starts to close, the mother in desperation tells Nightwing to take care of her son and get him away from there. But Nightwing tells her she has one chance as the front of the bus has a larger opening. He tells her he will meet her their and he's able to rescue her. Already tired and sore, he appreciates his small victory and goes off to see where else he can help.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #20
issues.story: " Cataclysm , Part Eleven: The Day After Judgment"

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin Dave Taylor

issues.synopsis:
A worried Nightwing busts through the door to the G.C.P.D building. To his relief he finds Barbara Gordon safe as he was worried something had happened to her. She tells him even though her building is quake proof she came over to the G.C.P.D building to help guide rescue efforts via Satellite Uplink. He then tells her to be quite so he can enjoy seeing her alive, the moment is interrupted by Robin who Nightwing is surprised to see because he thought he was still in Europe. Oracle and Robin greet each other each stating that it was finally nice to meet one another as it was their first time meeting. Robin goes on to explain that the reason he is there was because he couldn't reach Batman or the Batcave . Nightwing agrees to what Robin says as he couldn't either and he asks Oracle what she could tell them but to their dismay she hadn't heard from Batman thinking that they had.

Meanwhile Jim Gordon is discussing with the fire chief about the Davenport Center laying against Gotham Electric with all of Theater Row lying under it. The Fire Chief states how they're lucky that the earthquake happened before showtime as otherwise the theaters would be full. He then goes on to say how all eighty floors could drop any second and tells the Commissioner to get his men out in which the the Commissioner asks which of his men are in there. As he says this one of his men come out who's name is Detective Hawke, Gordon doesn't seem to remember his face as he says he always remembers faces but it turns out to be Batman in disguise.

Nightwing and Robin take one of Bruce's many vehicles around the city, up The Manchester Viaduct up into the reservoir, they go to Wayne Manor only to find most of it has collapsed into the cave. Oracle states that Bruce may be way past worrying about his alter-ego being revealed.

Batman disguised as Detective Hawke barely pulls the last person out before the Davenport center collapses completely. Robin worried about his father goes to check on him as Tim Drake and finds him to be safe, they then embrace in a hug. Nightwing makes his way down into the cave and finds Harold and Alfred to be safe, but neither have heard from Bruce either since he left the cave through a subterranean stream.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #21

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
The earthquake in Gotham also shook the city of Bludhaven and the run-down house Nightwing lives in is no longer safe. Bridget Clancy does not want Amygdala to enter the building because she fears it might crumble. And it gets worse as she receives a condemnation order from the court stating the inhabitants have to leave the house the next day at the latest.

While Nightwing hunts a burglar, Tad Ryerstad gets active as Nite-Wing for the first time. He intends to stop three muggers but they just shoot him to the ground.

As Dick returns home, he runs into his neighbors who inform him about the court's condemnation order. But Dick does not want to give up that fast, so he calls the original owner of the building and arranges a meeting with him.

In the Drexel Institute, Dudley Soames starts his rehabilitation program. Of course his body and his senses have a hard time adjusting to the fact that his head is still turned 180 degrees.

The next day, Bridget and other neighbors stand ready to oppose any tries to make them leave their homes. But the arriving crew of construction workers is not there to tear the house down. Instead they present Bridget a restoration plan for the building and all inhabitants receive hotel vouchers until the repairs are finished.

Meanwhile, Chief Redhorn gives Blockbuster a call and tells him that someone called Nightwing lies badly injured in hospital. Blockbuster senses the perfect opportunity to get rid of his foe once and for all ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #22

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Dick took Bridget Clancy to a movie and both are enjoying their date quite a bit. But suddenly Dick's beeper shows him that Oracle is trying to get in contact with him. On the phone she sounds a little hysteric because she heard Nightwing was shot and brought to a hospital. Of course, she is happy to find out that Dick is alive and well, but the unlucky person in the hospital (which is actually Tad Ryerstad ) still might be targeted by foes of Nightwing.

Leaving a rather angry Bridget behind, Nightwing takes off to the hospital. There he quickly finds the shot victim and carts him out of his room right before two police officers enter. They want to finish off the victim, the same goes for the two villains Stallion and Brutale who are present as well. The third party wanting a piece of Nightwing is the drug dealer Sulieman. But somehow Nightwing evades all of them. Sulieman and the police officers take care of each other and after defeating Stallion and Brutale, Dick brings Tad Ryerstad to the exit of the ambulance where Alfred Pennyworth is already waiting for him. Alfred promises to bring the victim to another clinic where he will be safe ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #23
issues.story: " Brotherhood of the Fist , Part Four: Paper Revelations"

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
The death of dozens of members of the Monkey Cult is being investigated by the Gotham City Police. Nightwing , Robin and Green Arrow observe the crime scene and hear that the brotherhood members were killed by someone using his bare hands. As the heroes think about potential suspects they are confronted by the Bamboo Monkey. Nightwing surprisingly gets struck down by the Bamboo Monkey, but the Green Arrow takes over and defeats his opponent very efficiently. Quickly after that they move on to Oracle who is worried because she lost contact with one of her operatives some time ago.

Meanwhile, Batman meets with Commissioner Gordon and tells him that he and his partners will take care of the Monkey Cult and the mysterious killer.

Somewhere in Asia, Black Canary and Bronze Tiger are approaching the temple of the Brotherhood of the Fist. But they are being watched closely and it does not take long until they are overwhelmed and imprisoned by Deathstroke and the Cult. But help is coming their way - it is Eddie Fyers .

Batman, Nightwing, Robin and Green Arrow continue their search for the Monkey Cult and the killer. They finally discover them in the crumbled Davenport Center where the female Paper Monkey is again busy killing members of her own brotherhood. And when she takes off her mask it is revealed she is no other than Lady Shiva ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #24

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Dick Grayson is working his shift in Hogan's Alley and listens to Police Inspector Morgan who will retire within the next few days. Morgan is telling him about a cold case - the important one in his career he never was able to solve. The case is about a shooting in which not only three of Eddie Minh's boys died, but an innocent bystander was killed as well. The last words of the dying old man sounded like "the boy with no hair".

After finishing work, Nightwing immediately visits the crime scene located in a part of Bludhaven which now is nearly abandoned. After studying some of the old case files Nightwing continues the investigation based on the "boy with no hair" clue. He "visits" a group of Aryans who prefer the bald look, but even after using some force these guys have no idea what shooting Dick is talking about.

After asking Oracle for support, Nightwing swings to the estate of Eddie Minh who still owes him a favor for saving his at that time unborn children. Nightwing breaks into the house, but Minh's wife catches him and Dick gets chased away by her bodyguards.

Running out of ideas, Nightwing once again goes to where the shooting took place. While thinking about how far the shooter might have been away from his victims, Dick spots a an old poster on a house wall. There are five children on it, and only one of them does not hold a hare in his arms. Nightwing figures the last words of the bystander actually were "the boy with no hare" and that he saw the shooter in the window above that kid. Nightwing searches the long abandoned apartment and finds one cartridge case. Oracle is able to identify finger prints on it - they belong to a contract killer Samson DeLyle who already is in prison and sentenced for life.

Dick gives Inspector Morgan an anonymous phone call. He lies that he once shared a prison cell with Samson DeLyle who told him he had been responsible for shooting Eddie Minh's boys years ago. Inspector Morgan cannot believe his luck and Nightwing is happy he was able to sweeten the retirement party of the old inspector ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #25

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing wants to spend some time with Robin and combines this with a little training session as both heroes hop onto a freight train - their eyes covered by blindfolds. While balancing on top of a container wagon on one leg, Robin tells Dick about his girlfriend Spoiler being pregnant although Tim was not responsible for this. Dick says that Spoiler is not a good choice as a girlfriend, but Tim does not think Dick is the right person to judge about this regarding his history with rather complicated women. Robin is surprised to hear that Dick also was involved with the Huntress recently.

After handling some turbulence on the train wagon, both talk about Jason Todd . Tim thinks he is too cautious sometimes compared to the former Robin, but is pleased to hear that Nightwing is not fearless himself. Batman , however, might be another story in that regard.

Suddenly, Nightwing and Robin are attacked by members of the gang called Rail Devils which is specialized on robbing trains. But even blindfolded the heroes get rid of their opponents quite easily and dump them into a shallow river.

Before jumping on a train driving back to Blüdhaven , Nightwing reveals that he took the department exam and intends to become a cop ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #26
issues.synopsis:
Dudley Soames has finished his rehabilitation and thanks Dr. Pavaar by killing her with his bare hands. Soames now uses mirror glasses to see what's in front of him and he is eager for revenge!

Meanwhile, Huntress is in Blüdhaven and takes down some thugs in a bar. She leaves a message for a man called Turk Fremunda that she is looking for him. Fremunda controls one of Blüdhaven's unions and after hearing about Huntress' threat he gladly accepts Cisco Blaine 's offer to quietly take care of her.

Tad Ryerstad has fully recovered from his gunshot wounds. He does not know that Nightwing took care of all the medical costs. His doctor advises him to stay out of trouble, but it does not look as if Tad wants to stop being Nite-Wing.

Dick Grayson has planned another date with Bridget Clancy and they are getting ready watching some movies in Bridget's apartment. As she prepares some popcorn, Dick watches news about a double murder which looks like a typical mob execution. He leaves without a word before Bridget comes back to the living room. A little later, Nightwing breaks into the morgue. The victims are Dandy Clemenceau, one of Fremunda's men, and Maynard Weaver, a union man from Gotham City . To be on the safe side, Dick leaves a spy camera to watch what the autopsy comes up with ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #27
issues.synopsis:
Dick Grayson is at home and watches the video footage sent from the morgue by his spy camera. After Bridget Clancy showed him exactly how bad she felt about him and his disapperaring act during their last date, Dick watches how the pathologist pulls out a piece of paper from the mouth of one of the victims. The word "Tattarattat" is written on that paper. Oracle tells him that the killer shot one hundred .45 slugs all from the same gun which gives Nightwing a clear indication which gun was used.

Chief Redhorn visits Turk Fremunda on his yacht and tells him about the message found in the mouth of his dead associate. Fremunda promises Redhorn to take care of this problem without the need to inform Blockbuster about it.

Nightwing visits a bar to get some information regarding Fremunda, but mosts guests are still shaken up by the beating they received from the Huntress . Dick finds it interesting that Helena is in Blüdhaven . Minutes after Dick left the bar, Dudley Soames enters and shoots down all the guests. He leaves the note "Reb Milton's Not Limber".

While Tad Ryerstad is looking to find the thugs who shot him, Huntress enters the apartment of Turk Fremunda. But Cisco Blaine is waiting for her and knocks her out with a tazer.

Nightwing does not have more success in catching Fremunda. He is able to stop his car and asks him about one of his guys meeting a Gotham contractor, but then Fremunda's girlfriend points a gun at Nightwing and he is forced to let them go.

Cisco Blaine has Huntress all tied up to a chair. He actually wants to use Huntress to eliminate Fremunda so that he can take his place as puppet master of the unions. Huntress might take the deal, but she makes clear that she will try to take out Blaine as well. Suddenly, the two are interrupted by Dudley Soames who now calls himself Torque ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #28
issues.synopsis:
Nightwing swings through the streets of Blüdhaven on his way to Turk Fremunda's apartment. There he not only finds the murderer he is looking for, but also the Huntress who just narrowly escapes the bullets shot by Dudley Soames who is calling himself Torque now. Huntress works together with Cisco Blaine and after Torque fled, she uses Blaine's taser on Nightwing.

The voice of Oracle wakes up Nightwing and she tells him that the messages left by the killer are palindromes i.e. they are spelled the same forwards and backwards. The message "Reb Milton's Not Limber" was a clue to the killer's next target which was the Hammer and Trowel bar. Nightwing still does not know the killer's identity, but he is sure it is not Huntress. Also, a short conversation with Batman confirms that Turk Fremunda might have his eyes on the big reconstruction projects in Gotham City .

Meanwhile, Fremunda picks up the union president who is under his control. In his limousine, Fremunda pulls a gun and directs it towards Cisco Blaine. Obviously, Fremunda saw through the charade of his associate and brings him to warehouse of a concrete factory. But not only Huntress followed him, but Nightwing and Torque arrive there a little later. Before Blaine gets killed, Huntress jumps into the warehouse ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #29

info.Editors: Joseph Illidge Scott Peterson Darren Vincenzo

issues.synopsis:
Huntress busts into Turk Fremunda's warehouse and prevents that his bodyguard kills Cisco Blaine who initially wanted to double-cross his boss. Nightwing is there as well and helps Huntress fighting Fremunda's thugs. The situation gets more chaotic as Torque shows up as well and then Nightwing and Huntress even kiss each other while hiding in a concrete ring.

As Torque lights a fire to burn both Blaine and Mr. Dennis who is the current union president, Nightwing makes his move to save them. But he is a little too late and only able to get Blaine out of the fire alive. And because he is occupied, Torque catches Fremunda and shoots him with his machine gun. Nightwing cannot believe that the killer he was looking for from the beginning is former Detective Dudley Soames. As he tries to evade the bullets, Huntress moves a large pile of concrete and buries Soames beneath it while Nightwing was able to get away in the last second. As always is not fond of Huntress' methods.

Helena hurt her ankle though, so Nightwing has to carry her away from the concrete factory because Blockbuster has sent a kill team for cleanup. Nightwing and Huntress do not realize that Torque is still alive and is taking care of the kill team himself.

In Dick's car they talk about their relationship. Nightwing thinks that Helena is not fighting for justice, but for revenge. And he does not want get involved in her "dark ways" any more ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #30

info.Editors: Joseph Illidge Darren Vincenzo Scott Peterson

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing just handles a van jacking when surprisingly Superman arrives to help him out. Superman accompanies Nightwing on patrol. Chief Redhorn holds a press conference talking about his action to handle all Gotham refugees coming to Bludhaven, but when the reporters see Superman flying by the police headquarters, Redhorn is no longer in the spotlight.

Superman and Nightwing arrive at the Zephraim Moore Housing project. The property has a new owner and a lawyer tells the Gotham refugees that they have to leave the area until next morning. Superman blows away the lawyer's paperwork to buy the people some time, but Nightwing wants to solve the problem at its root. He knows that the company which bought the premises belongs to Blockbuster . So Superman and Nightwing pay the crime boss a visit. They convince him to leave the refugees alone, otherwise Superman would come to Bludhaven more often and interfere in Blockbuster's other businesses. After leaving Superman tells Dick that Blockbuster has an enlarged heart and might not live another year. When Superman flies out of Bludhaven, Dick thinks about the distrust Batman has for Superman because he is not from Earth. But in Dick's eyes Superman is more human than anybody else.

Meanwhile, Nite-Wing plans his revenge on the thugs who shot him ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #31
issues.synopsis:
A scream wakes up Dick Grayson and he immediately runs out of his apartment. Bridget Clancy is confounded because she just received a property tax bill of more than 50,000 bucks. With all the Gotham City refugees coming to Bludhaven gentrification obviously cannot be avoided. Of course, Dick could pay the bill easily, but he needs a good cover up story to do so.

In the evening, Dick wants to take out Bridget to dinner. But because all of his favorite restaurants are crowded to the maximum, both end up eating hamburgers in Hogan's Alley . Although Bridget enjoys the evening, she cannot stop thinking of the tax bill. After leaving the pub, Bridget tells Dick that initially she intended to become a doctor. Dick says she should pursue this goal, but Bridget thinks he only makes fun of her.

The next morning, Bridgets mood is much better. Allegedly, the building is historically registered, and thus the tax bill is no longer a problem. Dick is happy that Bridget and the other neighbors are buying this fake story. Once again, he tells Bridget that she could become a doctor, e.g. with a scholarship from the Wayne Foundation. Changes in Dick's life are due as well because his training at the Police Academy will start soon.

Meanwhile, Nite-Wing found the thugs who shot him in a diner. He beats them to a pulp and then leaves them behind after setting the diner on fire ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #32
issues.synopsis:
Dick Grayson has started his training at the Police Academy. The physical training is no problem for him, and due to having learned from Batman, most of the classroom stuff is boring for him as well. The hardest job is to not draw too much attention on himself for being too good.

Meanwhile, Chief Redhorn has to pay Blockbuster a visit. There have been a number of burglaries in the last few nights and Blockbuster wants the police to take care of that. Redhorn immediately responds and Nightwing is the first recipient of a shoot to kill message by the police. When Nightwing sneaked out of the Academy, he quickly gets shot at by a SWAT team. And he has to work pretty hard to get rid of the police again. Meanwhile, the actual two thieves the police is looking for are pulling another successful heist. The duo comes from Europe's Circus Sensationnel and they call themselves Double Dare ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #33
issues.synopsis:
Although Batman never used guns or rifles, he knew everything about them and how to use them. And he trained Dick Grayson the same as well, so Dick feels pretty comfortable during his first training session at the shooting stand of the Police Academy. During lunch a fellow classmate introduces himself to Dick as Mac Arnot . Dick is a little puzzled, because up to this point Dick did not notice this guy.

In the evening, Blockbuster hires three villains to take care of the thieves who are hurting his organization more with every deed. Nightwing is also on their trail and visits Eddie Plenty, a receiver of stolen goods, to get some information. Indeed, Eddie knows of a location where the next heist might take place. Shortly after Nightwing sets up his observation there, an acrobatic young woman in yellow spandex shows up to loot the place. Nightwing interferes and follows her through half of Bludhaven . But when he is finally able to grab her, he gets hit in the face by the other part of the duo calling itself Double Dare .

Dick calls the director of the circus he owns and the old man tells him about two acrobatic sisters of the European Circus Sensational who currently is having shows in Bludhaven. Dick immediately goes to the circus site and attacks the women in their house trailer. However, Blockbuster's mercenaries also found their targets. The Electrocutioner welds all windows of the trailer shut and Stallion moves the trailer on a flatbed truck. Brutale is behind the wheel and the ride begins ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #34
issues.synopsis:
Nightwing is fighting the acrobatic female duo called Double Dare in their own circus trailer, all while the whole trailer was loaded on a flatbed truck by Brutale , Stallion and Electrocutioner . The villains are paid by Blockbuster to kill Double Dare and Nightwing knows he has to convince the two women to work together with him to get out of this situation alive.

Stallion and Electrocutioner decide to enter the trailer by ripping the roof open, but inside they see that the floor is open as well - looking as if their prey escaped. But Nightwing and Double Dare are still in the trailer and able to flee through the open roof. Originally, Double Dare was supposed to help Nightwing fighting the three villains, but they clear out at first opportunity. However, Nightwing beats his opponents anyway and then hops off the truck before it plunges into a river.

Meanwhile, Nite-Wing takes down some criminals, but the police officers arrest him. At the same time, Blockbuster has an appointment with a doctor who tells him that he will die soon because his heart is no longer able to support his huge body. Blockbuster threatens the doctor that he better find a solution for this problem.

Back in his apartment, Dick chats with Oracle but then the video feed gets interrupted by Batman who says he needs Nightwing in Gotham City ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #35

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Lock-Up has been running Blackgate Penitentiary since the beginning of No Man's Land and in the meantime he has allied with KGBeast and the Trigger Twins to control all of the inmates in Blackgate.

Over the course of NML, the prison has been filling up with criminals and Batman fears that they might realize the combined power all of them can be. Batman asked Nightwing to take control of Blackgate. Nightwing complains at first but after listening to Bruce's reasoning, he accepts the challenge. Batman goes on to take care of other important matters and Nightwing contacts Oracle to get some info before going in. Oracle informs Nightwing that there is a man inside Blackgate named Clyde Greenlaw that has similar physical appearance to him. Nightwing plans to disguise himself as Greenlaw and infiltrate in Blackgate. Greenlaw is a janitor working for Lock-Up in Blackgate.

Lock-Up arrives at Blackgate with a couple more criminals to put them in jail. As KGBeast is taking them to their cells, Nightwing arrives at Blackgate using a scuba gear. Nightwing climbs one the prison's walls and enters it through an opened crack.

Meanwhile in Bludhaven , Chief Redhorn and the police department have captured Nite-Wing and are questioning him. Somehow, Redhorn seems to sympathize with Nite-Wing's motives.

Back in Blackgate, Nightwing is inside the prison and finds that most of it is empty and destroyed. He searches for people until he finds Greenlaw. Nightwing tells Greenlaw that he is taking his place but Greenlaw doesn't like the idea of going to Gotham . Greenlaw starts screaming and runs away from Nightwing. The noise alerts the Trigger Twins of Nightwing's presence and they start shooting at him. Nightwing manages to escape them but he comes across KGBeast. Nightwing does his best to avoid the three of them but after a while they corner him. Nightwing uses his acrobat skills and takes the three of them down. He is contemplating his fallen adversaries when he receives an electric shock from behind. The charge is so powerful that it knocks him out immediately. Lock-Up was alerted by Greenlaw and now he is considering what to do with Nightwing.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #36

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing is lying unconscious in Blackgate Penitentiary after Lock-Up attacked him from behind. Lock-Up tells the Trigger Twins to carry him down to the hole where all the other inmates are being held. One of them tries to unmask Nightwing but Lock-Up prevents that from happening. When the Twins are about to drop Nightwing in the hole, they search his suit looking for Batarangs or any other weapons Nightwing has; but the suit protection system is enabled and they receive an electric shock. The Twins are mad and kick Nightwing while he is down and then they throw him into the hole.

After a while, Nightwing recovers and he realizes that he is surrounded by all of the Blackgate inmates. At once, Nightwing starts to fight all of them at the same time. His acrobatic skills helps him to reach the ceiling bars where he looks for a way out of the hole but on top of him is KGBeast who forces Nightwing down again. Jonathan Crane , a.k.a. The Scarecrow talks to the inmates and tells them that Nightwing's presence might be helpful for them. Garfield Lynns opposes that idea and wants to kill Nightwing as revenge for his burned skin. Black Mask is in favor of keeping Nightwing alive and so the inmates are divided into two groups and they start to fight each other.

Meanwhile in Bludhaven , Chief Redhorn grants Nite-Wing access to his personal files and records on the most prominent criminals in Bludhaven. Redhorn offers Nite-Wing the chance to work for him as his personal vigilante and Nite-Wing accepts the offer gladly. Elsewhere, Blockbuster is looking at the options for his heart transplant and when his mother listens to what is happening, Blockbuster tells her the truth. She is devastated.

Back in Blackgate, the inmates are killing each other and The Ventriloquist talks to them and makes them understand that Nightwing is their best option for getting out of there. Lock-Up and his men are worried for Nightwing's presence and they search the prison looking for Batman. They find nothing and Lock-Up is even more concerned. He asks Elmo Galvan's opinion and the man just laughs at them.

Lock-Up tries to speak to Nightwing down in the hole, but The Mad Hatter tells him that Steeljacket killed Nightwing and ate him. Tetch shows Lock-Up a skull as a proof. Lock-Up is convinced and Nightwing's plan is working. The inmates are gathered around Nightwing expecting him to come up with the next step of the plan. Nightwing looks around and notices that the walls are filled with gunpowder. The cellar is used as storage for weapons and the walls contain amounts of gunpowder. Nightwing tells the prisoners to start taking as much gunpowder as possible from the walls and he is expecting that it will be enough to blow up one of the walls.

Lock-Up is really worried now that he thinks that Nightwing was dead. He knows that Batman will show up any moment soon and he doesn't want the inmates getting the chance at freedom. Lock-Up decides that it is time to sentence all of them to their deaths.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #37
issues.synopsis:
Garfield Lynns and The Dynamiteer are arguing about the best way to use the gunpowder to blow up a wall. Nightwing works with the other inmates and they prepare a few charges of gunpowder to make their way out. Firefly and Dynamiteer start to fight each other and Nightwing is considering his options after blowing the wall.

Lock-Up is determined to kill all the inmates and he decides to do so by drowning them. With the help of KGBeast , Lock-Up opens a valve to let the sea water inside Blackgate Penitentiary 's cellar.

The explosive charges are ready and Nightwing plans to use them later but as the water begins entering the room, he decides that they must blew up the wall that moment. Nightwing sets the explosives in the wall and all of the inmates are ready for the explosion but nothing happens. A few seconds later, the gunpowder explodes and the wall comes crashing down. Nightwing and the others move to the open hole and Lock-Up notices their escape. Nightwing moves faster than the others and before they can turn their attention to him, Nightwing starts to climb up a pit using some hanging chains. The rest of the inmates try to follow him but he drops Monsoon on top of them all. Lynns is climbing as well and threatening Nightwing, who is climbing up faster until the KGBeast attacks him from above. The Beast has descended from the same hanging chains and is ready to kill Nightwing. Grayson uses his acrobatic skills to knock down the KGBeast and Lynns at the same time. Once he is outside of the pit, Nightwing is attacked by the Trigger Twins . Nightwing dodges their attacks and manages to escape their shooting range. Lock-Up appears and asks them about Nightwing. Without alarming them, Nightwing drops a wall of boxes full of supplies on the three of them and blocks the way out of the pit. All the villains are knocked down and incapacitated, but the feat costs Nightwing much effort and he is feeling sick, tired and wasted after all he's been through.

Nightwing calls the Gotham City Police Department and Mackenzie Bock moves to Blackgate with some reinforcements in order to take control of the prison and all the inmates. Bock reclaims Blackgate as part of Batman's territory.

In Gotham ; Oracle is working on her computer when she hears some weird noises coming from out of her main window. She arms herself and goes to see what it is. When she arrives, she sees Nightwing with his suit completely destroyed, soaking wet and clinging to the window. With his last breath, he tells Barbara that he found a blind spot in her security net and that she must fix it; then Nightwing collapses from exhaustion in Barbara's arms.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #38

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Dick Grayson wakes up from a dream in which he was diving in the air along with Barbara Gordon wearing her Batgirl suit. When he woke up, he realized he was in Barbara's bedroom. She had tended his wounds after his battle in Blackgate Penitentiary and when he was conscious, she kissed him in the forehead in order to check the fever. Then she told him that, if he was feeling better, she had prepared soup for him.

Outside of the Gotham Clock Tower ; a group of armed men are considering their options of breaking and entering the tower in order to steal all the information from Oracle's files. Some of them go to the sewers underneath the building, unaware of the set of traps placed by Oracle around the building. The couple that are in the sewers are sprayed with regurgitant gas and when they try to cut off the power to the building, they receive an electro-shock that incapacitates them.

Some of Barbara's monitors show alarms in different zones but she disregards them as she is confident that her traps will work fine and that she will start worrying when the alarm of zone 12 is activated. Barbara and Dick are having lunch in Barbara's kitchen and Dick mentions that he could get used to that situation, implying that he likes being with her. Barbara leaves the room as fast as she can and goes to work on her computers. Dick tries to talk about their situation and Barbara tries to avoid the subject. Dick convinces her that they need to talk about them. Barbara tells Dick about her situation and her feelings since she lost the mobility of her legs. She tells him that in order to move on, she has to let go of things that made her happy like walking, skating, feeling with her legs and ultimately, she has to let go of Dick. He tells her that it doesn't matter to him as she starts crying. Dick asks her what can he do and Barbara tells him to give her some time. Dick agrees and tells her that he missed her and Barbara tells him that he is also missing a shave; while the alarm in zone 6 is triggered.

The armed group is still trying to get inside but they aren't successful. Their leader tells them that they are going to attack from two sides: they will go and attack the front door while a secret contact of their leader will strike the roof.

Meanwhile, Barbara is shaving Dick and after she is done, she touches his face and tells him that he is fine. Dick tells her that he wants to be checked in the way she checked his fever. Barbara kisses him on the cheek and tells him that he passed the test. However, they are overwhelmed by their feelings and they kiss in a loving way. Dick reaches for Barbara and holds her in his arms while they keep kissing and embracing each other, more passionate with every passing second.

Barbara and Dick are interrupted when the alarm in zone 12 is activated and the men at the front door cause a big explosion. Dick takes his domino mask and grabs his escrima sticks to go and check out what is happening. Barbara tells him that they are attacked from the front door but that zone 12 is the roof. Dick isn't sure what to do and before he can decide, the armed men break inside the main room. The leader of the men reveals himself as Pettit . Nightwing knocks out two of Pettit's men and then tells the former police officer that he stepped over the line this time. Nightwing is very angry and tells Pettit that he better call for reinforcements and someone behind Barbara and Nightwing replies that he already did. It is Huntress , who entered the building by the roof.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #39

info.Cover Artists: Scott McDaniel Karl Story Patrick Martin

issues.synopsis:
Billy Pettit and his group of ex-police officers broke into Oracle's Watchtower and Huntress is helping them. Nightwing and Barbara Gordon are completely surrounded and Huntress taunts Nightwing by calling him lover, because of their previous relation . Barbara says three key words that activates a blinding light in the room that stuns all of the intruders. Nightwing takes a couple of guys down and then he takes down Huntress before taking Barbara with him to the safe room in the Watchtower.

Huntress is mad at Pettit for using extreme violence against Nightwing and Oracle and threatens him to stop the senseless violence. Pettit convinces her that he will change but that sometimes, extreme actions are required.

Meanwhile, in the safe room, Barbara is preparing all the traps installed in the Watchtower but she notices that Nightwing is too quiet. She looks for him and realizes that he is burning up with a fever. Nightwing mutters that it is nothing and when Barbara doesn't get the meaning, Nightwing explains that what happened between him and Huntress was nothing, just a mistake from the past and that he is over it now. Barbara is aware of that and then she triggers the traps in the building to gives them enough time to reach the elevator and get out of the tower.

Meanwhile in Bludhaven , Blockbuster continued to look for a heart to replace his own damaged organ. Thus, he made a deal with Grimm in order to find Gorilla City .

Back in Gotham, the traps in the tower gases, electrifies, creates a high pitch noise and shoots many of Pettit's people. The former police officer decides that he had enough and starts shooting at random in the tower. Huntress tries to stop him but Pettit goes berserk and is completely out of his mind. The attacks turns the power of the building off, leaving Nightwing and Barbara trapped in the elevator. They climb out and start talking about what just happened before they were interrupted. Barbara and Dick agreed that they both had strong feelings for each other but before they can decide what is their next step, Huntress opens the elevator door and jumps to where the couple is. She is running away from Pettit's massacre and she uses her knife to cut the elevator's lines off. The elevator drops but it is secured with emergency brakes. They reach the lower floor and get out of the broken elevator. A couple of Pettit's men try to stop them, but Barbara says another three key words and they fall in a water sink after the trap door on which they are standing is activated.

When they reach the garage, Huntress tells them that they might have time to get away and before leaving she kisses Nightwing by force in front of Barbara. Nightwing is shocked and can't stop her. Barbara is a bit mad but without delay, they get inside a truck and drive away from the watchtower. Barbara asks Nightwing what is he going to do next and he tells her that first he is talking to Batman and then, he will return to Bludhaven.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #40
issues.synopsis:
Dick Grayson , Bridget Clancy and John Law , formerly the Tarantula, are having breakfast together. Then suddenly John Law's mood changes and he takes an early leave. Later, Dick looks into the newspaper John was reading and quickly spots the article which might be worrying John. It is about Leopold Sturm, a Nazi from World War II who recently was released from a prison in Germany .

Dick tries to speak with John Law again, but the old man is still very tense and just wants to be left alone.

Nightwing follows John to a hotel where the Nazi and his wife, the Iron Fraulein, are attacking John who once brought Sturm to justice as Tarantula. Nightwing steps in and helps his neighbor to defeat them ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #41
issues.synopsis:
Nite-Wing is watching some of Ricky Noone's thugs how they are putting a guy named Mitch into the trunk of their car. Nite-Wing takes these guys out, ties them to the rear bumper of the car and then takes a ride with it.

Meanwhile, Dick Grayson reports back at the Police Academy. He has found a valid excuse for his absence from the academy (when he actually helped Batman in Gotham City during No Man's Land) and, thus, is allowed to finish his training and become a cop. Dick once again walks into Mac Arnot and continues to have a bad feeling about this guy.

Detective Phil Addad interrogates Mitch who was found by the police in the trunk of a car which also had to dead bodies attached to it. Mitch has no useful information for the detective, so Addad lets him go knowing that Ricky Noone will take care of him. Indeed, Ricky picks up Mitch right outside the precinct. Mitch confesses that he heard one of Ricky's men say "Nightwing" while he was in the trunk. Noone immediately informs Blockbuster about that.

Days later, Dick graduates from the Police Academy and Bridget Clancy is there to celebrate with him. She tells her that she took his advice and got a scholarship from Waynetech.

Nite-Wing was not too pleased that his last deed was not a huge media hit. Therefore, he visits Chief Redhorn and tells him that he not only wants to take down Ricky Noone, but he also wants to be on the front page of the newspapers ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #42
issues.synopsis:
Together with Bridget Clancy , Dick Grayson is in Hogan's Alley celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy. Now his next goal is to become a member of the Bludhaven P.D. Later, Dick and Bridget walk back to the apartment house and eventually they kiss each other.

At about the same time, Nite-Wing has stolen a garbage truck and uses the vehicle to push the limousine of mob boss Ricky Noone off the street. The car crashes into a pylon and explodes.

The next morning, Dick asks for a job in the Bludhaven P.D. But not only is his application denied, he also finds out that Mac Arnot already has a job at the P.D. What Dick does not know yet is that Mac Arnot is becoming the new inspector, taking the vacant position of Dudley Soames .

Nightwing talks with Oracle because he wants her to check on the history of Mac Arnot. Oracle informs Dick that there is a power vacuum in Bludhaven and that Alistair Bendel-White, former fixer for Intergang, has set up office in Bludhaven.

Meanwhile, Blockbuster is talking on the phone with Chief Redhorn about finding the murderer of Ricky Noone. According to Redhorn this thing will work itself out, but Blockbuster senses that his power over people is fading.

Nightwing breaks into the office of Alistair Bendel-White and surprisingly meets Nite-Wing there. While Dick starts to talk Nite-Wing out of the vigilante business, suddenly Torque appears and he is throwing some charged dynamite in their direction ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #43
issues.synopsis:
Nightwing and Nite-Wing barely escape the explosion caused by Torque . Despite what happened Dick still wants to talk with Nite-Wing about his future as a vigilante.

Blockbuster is not too pleased that there is a gang war happening as if he was already dead. But he continues to search for a replacement heart, thus, has captured the gorilla Grimm . Blockbuster wants to know the location of Gorilla City, but Grimm is not yet willing give him that information.

Meanwhile, Nightwing and Nite-Wing have to flee from the explosion scene because a SWAT team has arrived as well. Now Nightwing is sure they were set up. Chief Redhorn gets informed about the two fleeing the scene, so the Chief decides to give new Inspector Mac Arnot his first case. Nightwing tells Nite-Wing that he needs training if he wants to stay in business and, therefore, offers to coach him.

Back in his apartment, Dick is visited by Bridget Clancy . She presents him a framed photo of them together at the graduation celebration. It becomes obvious that she is interested in a closer relationship with Dick. But he is retreating because he has feelings for a woman he already knows for a long time. Bridget plays it cool, but she cries after leaving Dick's apartment. Later at night, Nightwing meets Nite-Wing and they start Tad's superhero training.

At the same time, Torque has kidnapped Alistair Bendel-White. He offers Intergang to run the city in the future as long as Torque himself can have the spotlight as kind of an ambassador of Blüdhaven ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #44
issues.synopsis:
Nite-Wing breaks into the home of Chief Redhorn to take revenge because the cop set him up recently. Redhorn tries to calm Nite-Wing down, but then fires with two guns at him. But Nite-Wing has gotten better and is able to knock the Chief down. He wants all files on Blockbuster and Redhorn agrees to give them to Nite-Wing. His hopes are that Desmond will take care of the vigilante.

Blockbuster has other problems though. His IT specialist still has no clue who Oracle is or if that cyber legend really exists. But certainly Desmond has lost a lot of money because of Oracle. Meanwhile, exactly that Oracle tells Nightwing that Mac Arnot was the son-in-law of Jimmy Navarone, a former vicelord in Gotham City. Obviously, that background did not stop Mac Arnot to become a cop in Bludhaven .

The kidnapped Alistair Bendel-White has made phone contact with the council of Intergang . Torque wants to work together with them to take over Bludhaven. At the same time, Chief Redhorn decides to leave the city for a while and that Mac Arnot should take over his duties.

Later, Nightwing meets Nite-Wing who proudly presents him all files on Blockbuster. Nite-Wing now wants to confront Blockbuster directly and surprisingly Nightwing agrees. While Dick directly approaches Blockbuster, Nite-Wing takes another entrance. But there he is quickly spotted by the gorilla Grimm . And Grimm does not only knock out Nite-Wing, but his partner Nightwing as well. Blockbuster is pleased with Grimm's work, but now he intends to find Oracle ...

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 2 #45
issues.story: "The Hunt for Oracle, Part One: To the Slaughter"
